subject: physics
question_text: State the sign of the work done by a force in the following: a) work done by a man in lifting a bucket out of a well by means of a rope tied to the bucket; b) work done by the gravitational force in the same case.

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), Unit 6 VERY SHORT ANSWER. The 1+1 mark split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher; no exam appearance years are printed for this question, so appearances[] stays empty. The TSBIE Basic Learning Material has no VSAQ section for this unit, so the Fastrack is the only source for it.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: a) The man
lines: The man pulls the rope upward and the

lines.text: W = F S cos 0° = + F S

lines: The work done by the man is POSITIVE.
steps.margin_note: Give the angle, then the sign. The angle is the reason and it earns the mark.
steps.why: Force and displacement point the same way, so the man is adding energy to the bucket.
common_mistakes: Answering "positive" with no angle, so there is no reason on the page.

recall.must_convey: That the work done by the man is positive because the force and displacement are both upward.
accept: theta is zero so it is positive

steps.memory_tip: Force up, motion up: same direction, positive work.

steps.label: b) Gravity
lines: Gravity acts downward while the bucket

lines.text: W = F S cos 180° = − F S

lines: The work done by gravity is NEGATIVE.
steps.margin_note: θ = 180° is the whole of part (b). Write the angle before the sign.
steps.why: Gravity opposes the motion here, so it takes energy out — exactly the energy stored as potential energy on the way up.
common_mistakes: Answering zero because the bucket moves at a steady speed. Steady speed means the TOTAL work is zero, not gravity’s share.

recall.must_convey: That the work done by gravity is negative because it acts opposite to the displacement.
accept: theta is one eighty so it is negative

steps.memory_tip: Gravity down, motion up: opposite directions, negative work.

insider_note: One mark each part, and a bare positive or negative with no angle earns nothing — the θ line is the answer and the sign is its label.
